gloss: to ache; to throb; to tingle

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: うずいていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To experience a dull, throbbing pain, typically in a localized area of the body.
To feel a strong emotional longing or anticipation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古傷|ふるきず}→古傷：17166_furukizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく。
⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずいて⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: My cavity is throbbing and I can't sleep.
On rainy days, my knee sometimes aches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冒険心|ぼうけんしん}→冒険心：17815_boukenshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく。
examples.english: My sense of adventure is tingling (I'm itching for adventure).

examples.japanese: ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずいて、⟦じっとして→じっとする：25342_jittosuru⟧⟦いられなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My blood was stirring and I couldn't sit still.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{弾|ひ}きたい→弾く：02444_hiku⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずいた。
examples.english: When I saw a guitar for the first time in a while, the urge to play welled up inside me.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). No pair verb.

ASPECT (ている):
うずいて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing throbbing pain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく (wound throbs)
- ⟦{古傷|ふるきず}→古傷：17166_furukizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく (old wound aches)
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく (tooth aches)
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく (blood stirs - feeling excitement)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{古傷|ふるきず}→古傷：17166_furukizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく is sometimes used metaphorically to mean being reminded of past painful experiences or mistakes.
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずく expresses a strong, almost instinctive urge or excitement.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ずきずき→ずきずき：05262_zukizuki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to throb (more acute, sharp pain)
- ⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧ - to hurt/ache (general pain)
